name: Amayo no Mayoi Neko
source:
On his way home from work, the protagonist Shin meets a girl who is sheltering from the rain.

The rain had soaked the girl's uniform, prompting the good-natured Shin to give her the umbrella he had with him.

But she doesn't use the umbrella at all. Rather, she chooses to follow him.

Is this some new kind of stalker?

Shin ran away in an attempt to get rid of her, but...

[translated from [url=http://niji-kata.jpn.org/work/ameyono/ameyono.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角申在下班回家的路上遇到了一个正在避雨的女孩。

雨水浸湿了女孩的制服，好心的申把随身携带的雨伞送给了她。

但她根本不使用伞。相反，她选择跟随他。

这是某种新的跟踪者吗？

申逃跑了，试图摆脱她，但是……

[翻译自[url=http://niji-kata.jpn.org/work/ameyono/ameyono.html]官方网站[/url]]
